invalidation.zh: 失效条件：价格跌破2300（基于ATR 23.56调整，约-3%），或融资费率Z-score转正>50%（空头压力缓解），或Qlib评分跌出前三，或日线趋势转熊（价格<SMA50）。
invalidation.en: Invalidation condition: Price breaks below 2300 (adjusted based on ATR 23.56, ~-3%), or funding Z-score turns positive >50% (short pressure eases), or Qlib score falls out of top 3, or daily trend turns bearish (price < SMA50).

invalidation.zh: 失效条件：价格突破0.095（基于ATR 0.0009调整，约+2.4%），或融资费率Z-score降至<50%（多头压力缓解），或日线趋势转牛（价格>SMA50），或Qlib评分跌出前三。
invalidation.en: Invalidation condition: Price breaks above 0.095 (adjusted based on ATR 0.0009, ~+2.4%), or funding Z-score falls to <50% (long pressure eases), or daily trend turns bullish (price > SMA50), or Qlib score falls out of top 3.

invalidation.zh: 失效条件：价格跌破73000（基于ATR 491.78调整，约-1.8%），或融资费率Z-score转正>50%（空头压力缓解），或日线趋势转熊（价格<SMA50），或Qlib评分跌至底部（如<0）。
invalidation.en: Invalidation condition: Price breaks below 73000 (adjusted based on ATR 491.78, ~-1.8%), or funding Z-score turns positive >50% (short pressure eases), or daily trend turns bearish (price < SMA50), or Qlib score falls to bottom (e.g., <0).
